_about: The v1b bridge as built, pin by pin, read off the bench's eye (tools/eye.py frames at zoom 300 and 500).
done: the wire at this pin was seen in the right hole. check: built, but it reads wrong or the eye cannot settle it; the note says what to look at.
A pin not listed is not built yet, or was not part of this pass, and the marked sheet leaves it in full colour.
Drawn by tools/wiring-diagram.py into docs/wiring-v1b-build.svg; a key that names no pin on the sheet stops the tool.
The camera sits off to one side, so a housing or a chip leg lands a fraction of a hole away in the picture: a one-hole call is a question for a meter.
scope: grounds, +5 V and the J1 console side

U2.8.note: U2-8 GND: reported fixed at 14:45; the camera at 14:50 still shows the grey wire's tip in pin 7's row (/QH), one hole above pin 8. Move it one hole toward the chip's end.

U2.10.note: U2-10 DS: reported fixed at 14:45; the camera at 14:50 still shows no wire on pin 10's row. It needs a stub to GND.

U1.7.note: U1-7 GND: the grey tip reads between pin 6 (3Y, an output) and pin 7. Seat it in pin 7's row, the chip's end.

J1.3.note: J1-3 OUT0 (black): now reads on U1-1; at 12:40 it read on pin 2. Beep OUT0 to U1-1.

U1.1.note: U1-1: the stub from the UNO side lands one column below the ribbon's yellow (D5), on the green (D3, TRIG). Move it up one hole.

A1.D5 (T1).note: A1 D5 to U1-1: nothing on the yellow's column; see the U1-1 note.

A1.D2 (INT0).note: A1 D2 to U2-2: the brown link runs from the blue's column to U2-2's column. Reads right; beep D2 to U2-2.

J1.4.note: J1-4 D0 (green): the housing covers the rows of U2-9 and U2-10 and leans to pin 9. Beep D0 to U2-9, and not to U2-10.

U2.9.note: U2-9 QH: see the J1-4 note.

A1.5V.note: A1 5V to the + rail: the feed is off the top of the camera's view. Meter it.

A1.GND.note: A1 GND to the GND rail: off the top of the camera's view. Meter it.

rails.note: Rails: the two red links between the left and right boards are one colour and cross at the left end; they read + to + and GND to GND. The orange (+) and brown (GND) feeds into the middle board's rail read right. Meter + to + before power: a swap reverses every chip.

not_seen: No 100 nF decoupling capacitors are fitted yet (C1 to C3). U1's and U3's pin-1 notches face up, the way the wiring expects; U2's is under the blue lead, so check it faces up too.
